question: Why was the corn straw–oil sludge composite fuel made with 60% oil sludge?
expect: It was not: it holds 40% oil sludge (corn straw/oil sludge 60/40); more than 40% oil sludge gave ash above 12% and poor durability (sec. 2.1)
